display.label: AWS VPC Peering
display.description: Establish private networking connections between Amazon Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs)

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name for the VPC Peering connection, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core connection settings including name and local/peer VPC IDs.

fields.label: Connection Name
fields.description: Unique name for the VPC Peering Connection, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: Connection name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: Requester VPC ID
fields.description: The ID of the local VPC requesting the peering connection.

fields.label: Accepter VPC ID
fields.description: The ID of the target VPC accepting the peering connection.

sections.label: Cross-Account & Options
sections.description: Configure cross-account details, cross-region settings, and DNS resolution.

fields.label: Peer AWS Account ID
fields.description: The AWS Account ID of the peer VPC owner (leave blank if same account).

fields.label: Peer AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS Region of the peer VPC (leave blank if same region).

fields.label: Auto-Accept Connection
fields.description: Automatically accept the peering connection (valid for same-account and same-region VPCs).

fields.label: Allow Remote VPC DNS Resolution
fields.description: Allow resolving public DNS hostnames of peer VPC instances to private IP addresses.
